title: Elegant 5BR Rosemary Beach Home with Private Beach Access
meta_description: Relax in this elegant 5BR, 5.5BA Rosemary Beach, FL home with private beach access, a private pool, a spacious great room, and a carriage house. Sleeps 12.
description_expanded: DescriptionThe Harper Cottage & Carriage House in Rosemary Beach offers the feel of a French country manor, with whitewashed walls, wood beams, and an air of effortless elegance. As you enter through the curved door, you’ll find yourself in the spacious great room. To your left is a formal dining room, with a long table for 8, in front of a bank of windows. Other amenities include a wet bar and beverage refrigerator.The kitchen is fit for the most sophisticated of chefs, with marble counters, limestone backsplash, and professional-grade stainless steel appliances. A generous island offers seating for 5. The open floor plan flows easily into the living room, where you’ll find seating for 7 in neutral relaxing tones. A large flat-screen TV offers evening entertainment. A private courtyard is complete with a saltwater pool, seating for 5, and a natural gas grill.The first-floor bedroom suite offers a queen bed with dual nightstands and lamps, a side chair, a double dresser, flat-screen TV, and a private bath with a walk-in shower. A first-floor half bath is for the convenience of the whole group.The 2nd-floor master is a true sanctuary, offering a private living area with a sofa and side chair. A comfy king-size bed offers a luxurious respite with dual nightstands and lamps. A flat-screen TV entertains. The ensuite bath offers a freestanding tub, dual vanities, and a walk-in shower with dual shower heads. A separate water closet, large walk-in closet, and dressing area offer privacy.The second bedroom suite offers built-in bunks and a large daybed, a large dresser, and a flat-screen TV. The ensuite bath features a walk-in shower. The third bedroom suite offers a queen bed, dual nightstands and lamps, a side chair, and flat-screen TV. An ensuite bath offers a generous walk-in shower.The separate, proper 1-bedroom carriage house is a lovely extension of the main home, with relaxing neutral decor. The welcoming living room offers a large sectional sofa and a flat-screen TV. A separate conversation area with two side chairs is located directly behind.A full kitchen offers the same amenities as the main home, as in solid-surface counters, stainless steel appliances, and generous prep space. The center island seats 4. The bedroom boasts a queen-size bed, dual nightstands, and lamps. Other features include a large dresser and flat-screen TV. A gracious bath has a walk-in shower.This stately family vacation residence is just waiting to make new and precious memories for your family! Call us today to reserve this special home.HOME HIGHLIGHTS* Complete Clean Bedding Program* Private courtyard with heated saltwater pool (Pool heat may be added for $45/day plus tax)* Chef’s kitchen with marble counters, limestone backsplash, professional-grade stainless steel appliances* All bedrooms have ensuite baths* Private 1-bedroom carriage house* 4 Complimentary Adult Beach Cruiser BikesFIRST FLOOR* Dining area with table for 8, wet bar, beverage refrigerator* Kitchen with marble counters, limestone backsplash, professional stainless steel appliances, center island with seating for 5* Living room with seating for 7, flat-screen TV, fireplace* GUEST BEDROOM with queen bed, dual nightstands, lamps, double dresser, HDTV, side chair* GUEST BATH with walk-in shower* Half-bathSECOND FLOOR* MASTER BEDROOM with King bed, dual nightstands, lamps, sofa, side chair, dresser, HDTV* MASTER BATHROOM with dual vanities, freestanding tub, walk-in shower with dual shower head, water closet, walk-in closet, dressing area* GUEST BEDROOM with built-in twin bunks, daybed, dresser, HDTV* GUEST BATHROOM with walk-in shower* GUEST BEDROOM with queen bed, dual nightstands, lamps, side chair, dresser, HDTV* GUEST BATH with walk-in shower* LaundryCARRIAGE HOUSE* Living room with sectional sleep sofa* Full kitchen with stainless steel appliances* Center island with seating for 4* MASTER BEDROOM with queen bed, dual nights
